commands.does: Reserve the idea for a few hours.
Withdraw your own request for changes, for exactly that commit, named by its full hash. No change needs an approval here.
Stop a change that passes the gates: it does not merge until the same person approves its head commit.
Accept a saving below the minimum for exactly that commit; it must still lower the score by at least 1.
Put the idea into the queue.
Close it; give the reason in the same comment.
commands.where: a proposed idea or an application

commands.does: Open an application for leaders to judge.

deny.description: native_decide and other ways of trusting compiled code instead of the proof kernel.
deny.name: native evaluation

deny.description: unsafe, implemented_by, extern, opaque and similar escape hatches.
deny.name: escape hatches

deny.description: Code that runs during compilation (#eval, run_cmd, elab, initialize).
deny.name: compile-time code

deny.description: Metaprogramming (MetaM, TacticM, simproc, run_tac, open Lean, IO): proofs are written with existing tactics, not new ones.
deny.name: metaprogramming

deny.description: More macros, syntax or notation than there are today (no private shorthand languages).
deny.name: macros and notation

deny.description: More maxHeartbeats overrides than there are today, or any above 4,000,000.
deny.name: maxHeartbeats

deny.description: More raised resource limits (maxRecDepth, synthInstance.maxSize, exponentiation.threshold) than there are today.
deny.name: resource limits

gates.description: The title follows `technique(scope): summary` and the description names the idea it implements (and, if it is built on another open change, that change), so every change can be identified and grouped.
gates.label: Standard title and description

gates.description: One author may have only a limited number of changes in verification at once, so the build queue stays available to everyone.
gates.label: Within the open-change limit

gates.description: The statement of the theorems, the toolchain, the dependency pins and the harness configuration must be byte-identical to the main branch.
gates.label: Frozen files untouched

gates.description: Only files inside the project directory may change.
gates.label: Changes stay in scope

gates.description: No new axioms, no unchecked native evaluation, no escape hatches, no code that runs during the build, and no protected declaration removed.
gates.label: No banned constructs

gates.description: The number of lines over the length limit, and of constructs the project tolerates but wants no more of (private macro languages, raised resource limits), may not grow.
gates.label: No more long lines or exceptions

gates.description: No line the change adds is over the length limit or ends in whitespace. A line is added if its file has more lines with exactly that text than before, so a line that only moved is not.
gates.label: Added lines are clean

gates.description: A declaration the change deletes is not named in any comment or doc comment afterwards. (Code that still names it does not compile, which the build decides.)
gates.label: No deleted name still mentioned

gates.description: What the rules of conduct say about automation and can be counted in the text: calls of search tactics, local simp attributes and their scope and comment, global attributes and instance priorities, and comments on added `clear` tactics and switched-off simp lemmas. Each count is compared with the same count in the same file before the change.
gates.label: Automation within the stated limits

gates.description: Comments and string literals do not count toward the score, so their growth in one change is limited, and no added comment or string may contain a link.
gates.label: Added comments within limits

gates.description: The primary metric must drop by at least the minimum step and no guard metric may rise beyond its tolerance.
gates.label: Score improves

gates.description: The full project builds on the pinned toolchain with no unfinished proofs.
gates.label: Project compiles

gates.description: An independent checker with a second proof kernel confirms the original theorem statements are still proved from the standard axioms only.
gates.label: Same theorems proved

gates.description: The verification ran on top of the latest main branch.
gates.label: Verified on current main

metrics.description: Source tokens after removing comments and whitespace. Reformatting cannot change it.
metrics.label: Tokens

metrics.description: Lines that contain at least one token.
metrics.label: Lines of code

metrics.description: Theorems, lemmas, definitions, structures, instances and similar.
metrics.label: Declarations

metrics.description: Size of the measured source files.
metrics.label: Bytes

metrics.description: Wall-clock time of the verification build. Informational.
metrics.label: Build time

settings.Approvals required: none: a change merges when its gates pass
settings.Local simp attributes: allowed under conditions, at most 10 in a file
settings.Search tactics to shorten proofs: allowed under conditions, at most 10 in a file

techniques.description: Use a lemma or definition from the library instead of a local one.
Replace several special cases with one general statement.
A shorter proof of the same statement.
Reorganize definitions or the argument so that less is needed.

title_format: <technique>(<scope>): <summary> where technique is one of dead-code, library, merge, generalize, shorten, restructure; scope is the file or folder under the project directory without .lean (for example Paper/Tree), or * for many; and the summary is 10 to 90 characters
